note: Aligned Oct 14, 2026 to Agent A's authoritative pack file patterns/python-upgrade.json (12 patterns, IDs PYUP001-PYUP012, no hyphen). Slugs/files are this suite's fixture naming.

patterns.description: Import of an abstract base class from collections instead of collections.abc (aliases removed in Python 3.10).
patterns.reference: Python 3.10 What's New, Removed: aliases to ABCs in collections removed

patterns.description: Use of asyncio.coroutine decorator, removed in Python 3.11.
patterns.reference: Python 3.11 What's New, Removed: asyncio.coroutine removed

patterns.description: Call to inspect.getargspec or inspect.getargvalues format helpers removed in Python 3.11 (getargspec removed).
patterns.reference: Python 3.11 What's New, Removed: inspect.getargspec removed

patterns.description: Import of the imp module, removed in Python 3.12; use importlib instead.
patterns.reference: PEP 594 / Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: imp module removed

patterns.description: Import of distutils, removed in Python 3.12; use setuptools or stdlib equivalents.
patterns.reference: PEP 632 / Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: distutils deprecated in 3.10 and removed in 3.12

patterns.description: Use of configparser SafeConfigParser or readfp, removed in Python 3.12.
patterns.reference: Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: configparser Legacy API removed (SafeConfigParser, readfp)

patterns.description: Use of deprecated camelCase threading aliases such as currentThread, activeCount, or Thread.isDaemon, removed in Python 3.10/3.12 cleanups.
patterns.reference: Python 3.10 What's New: threading camelCase aliases removed; Python 3.12 removals of remaining deprecated threading helpers

patterns.description: Use of removed unittest aliases failUnless, failIf, assertEquals, assertNotEquals, assertAlmostEquals spelled without the modern names (removed in Python 3.12).
patterns.reference: Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: unittest deprecated aliases removed

patterns.description: Call to ssl.wrap_socket or ssl.match_hostname, removed in Python 3.12; use SSLContext.wrap_socket.
patterns.reference: Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: ssl.wrap_socket and ssl.match_hostname removed

patterns.description: Import of typing.io or typing.re pseudo-modules, removed in Python 3.12.
patterns.reference: Python 3.12 What's New, Removed: typing.io and typing.re removed

patterns.description: Call to locale.getdefaultlocale, deprecated since Python 3.11 and scheduled for removal; use getlocale or explicit locales.
Use of datetime datetime.utcnow or datetime.utcfromtimestamp, deprecated in Python 3.12 in favour of timezone-aware calls.
patterns.reference: Python 3.12 What's New, Deprecations: datetime.utcnow and utcfromtimestamp deprecated

proposed_patterns.description: fractions.gcd (removed in 3.9, use math.gcd). Fixture pair kept as a proposal: the v1.0.0 pack does NOT contain this pattern, so core scan tests do not expect a hit.
